narrative.overview: The interface is the digital expression of the VAELORA icon, rendered in five metals: deep brown premium surfaces as black chrome, important cream as platinum, gold as polished gold, terracotta as copper and olive as green metal. Black chrome feature surfaces carry the decision and the recorder; warm cream carries reading; the stitch band, in platinum thread, appears where the icon band would.
keyCharacteristics: One black chrome feature band per screen, closed by the icon stitch band in platinum thread.
Polished gold marks the best moment; copper marks motion.
Green metal and gold carry conditions; poor conditions read as steel.
A tracked classical serif wordmark beside the real app icon.
Warm cream ground with dark brown ink; the only cool tones are chrome and platinum. No blue, lime, purple or neon.

rules.name: The Gold Moment Rule
rules.body: Gold marks the single best moment (the recommended window, the V tip). It never decorates.

rules.name: The Motion Rule
rules.body: Copper means movement or action: Start, Resume, recording, the live route.

rules.name: The Thread Rule
rules.body: Conditions use the metals: green metal comfortable, gold acceptable, steel poor. Decorative stitches are platinum.

rules.name: The Quiet Serif Rule
rules.body: The serif appears only in the wordmark and display lines, never in controls, labels or numbers.

rules.name: The Metal Rule
rules.body: Brand colour that acts, marks, measures or selects is metal (one light from the top left, brushed grain, specular edge, mid-tone under text, edge shade, tinted shadow). Grounds and reading surfaces stay calm. Gold is never a large area. No idle shine.

dos: Do use the real app icon (cropped from the identity sheet) wherever the brand mark appears.
Do close dark feature surfaces with the stitch band, once per surface.
Do keep numbers in Archivo tabular figures and Western digits in both languages.
Do keep notices neutral with a status dot.
donts: Don't use embroidery as a background texture or on every card.
Don't introduce cool blues, lime, purple or neon accents.
Don't set controls, labels or metrics in the serif.
Don't redraw the V; use the identity artwork.
Don't add eyebrow labels or em dashes in interface copy.
